name: Prestige One Developments
tagline: Dubai developer behind Vista and The Residence, part of Prestige Holding Group
founder: Ajmal Saifi, Founder and CEO
description: Prestige One Developments is the property development arm of Prestige Holding Group, a family business established in 1968 whose Dubai real estate investments date from 2007. The company's own timeline marks 2023 as the year it began operating as a developer in its own right. It is led by founder and chief executive Ajmal Saifi, and works from offices at Marina Plaza in Dubai Marina.

Its portfolio is concentrated in mid-market and upper mid-market apartment buildings across Dubai, including Vista and Golf Residences in Dubai Sports City, The Residence and Berkeley Square in Jumeirah Village Circle, and schemes on Dubai Islands, at Meydan Horizon and in Dubai Maritime City. Handovers at Vista have begun, and the company has said it intends to expand its pipeline further across the emirate.

name: Nakheel
tagline: Dubai master developer of Palm Jumeirah, now part of Dubai Holding
founder: Sheikh Ahmed bin Saeed Al Maktoum, Chairman
description: Nakheel is a Dubai master developer best known for Palm Jumeirah, the reclaimed island it delivered off the Jumeirah coast. Established in 2003 as part of the state-owned Dubai World group, it passed to the Government of Dubai after a debt restructuring, and in March 2024 was merged into Dubai Holding on the instruction of Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum.

The company continues to trade under its own name within Dubai Holding Real Estate. Its master developments include Palm Jumeirah, Palm Jebel Ali, Dubai Islands, The World and District One, alongside established residential communities such as Al Furjan, Jumeirah Village Circle, Jumeirah Park and Discovery Gardens. Its retail assets include Ibn Battuta Mall and Dragon Mart, and recent launches include Bay Grove Residences and Como Residences.

name: Meraas
tagline: Design-led Dubai developer of City Walk and Bluewaters, part of Dubai Holding
founder: Sheikh Ahmed bin Saeed Al Maktoum, Chairman
description: Meraas is a Dubai developer and asset owner formed in 2007, known for design-led destinations rather than conventional subdivisions. In 2020 it was brought under Dubai Holding by decree, and it now trades as part of Dubai Holding Real Estate alongside Nakheel and Dubai Properties. Its best-known schemes are City Walk, the low-rise retail and residential district in Al Wasl, and Bluewaters, the island that carries Ain Dubai.

The portfolio also takes in La Mer and Port de La Mer on the Jumeirah coast, Madinat Jumeirah Living, Jumeira Bay, Pearl Jumeira and Marsa Al Arab. More recent launches move inland and suburban: Nad Al Sheba Gardens, the villa community The Acres, and Design Quarter at Dubai Design District, the first residential addresses within d3. Meraas also holds hospitality and leisure assets across the city.

name: Meydan
tagline: Dubai developer of Meydan Racecourse and Meydan City, now part of Dubai Holding
description: Meydan is a Dubai developer and asset owner created around the Meydan Racecourse at Nad Al Sheba, which opened in 2010 and hosts the Dubai World Cup. The group was launched in 2007 under the patronage of Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, and its remit widened from the racecourse to master development across the surrounding district.

In March 2024 Sheikh Mohammed ordered Meydan merged with Nakheel under Dubai Holding, and the boards of both companies were dissolved. Meydan's name remains attached to Meydan City, the Meydan One masterplan, District One in Mohammed Bin Rashid City, developed with Sobha, and the Meydan Horizon masterplan opposite the racecourse. Much of the surrounding residential supply is now built by third-party developers on Meydan land.

name: Emaar Properties
tagline: Dubai's master developer, behind Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai
founder: Mohamed Alabbar, Founder and Managing Director
description: Emaar Properties was founded and incorporated in Dubai in 1997 by Mohamed Alabbar, and is listed on the Dubai Financial Market. It built Downtown Dubai, the district that contains Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall, Dubai Opera and the Dubai Fountain. Alabbar stepped down as chairman in December 2020 and continues as managing director; Amit Jain is chief executive of the group.

Beyond Downtown, Emaar's master communities include Dubai Marina, Arabian Ranches, Emirates Living, Dubai Hills Estate, Dubai Creek Harbour, Emaar Beachfront, Emaar South, The Valley and The Oasis. The company reports more than 130,900 homes delivered and a land bank of around 590 million square feet, and it also operates hotels, malls and leisure assets in Dubai and overseas markets.

name: Eagle Hills
tagline: Abu Dhabi developer of waterfront destinations in the UAE and abroad
founder: Mohamed Alabbar, Founder and Chairman
description: Eagle Hills is a privately held developer established in Abu Dhabi in January 2014 by Mohamed Alabbar, who also founded Emaar Properties. The two companies are separate. Eagle Hills concentrates on large mixed-use waterfront masterplans, usually delivered in partnership with governments or state investment bodies, and works across the Middle East, Africa, Europe and, more recently, the Indian Ocean.

In the UAE its work is concentrated outside Dubai. Ramhan Island, off Abu Dhabi, is planned around villas, marina residences and a hotel; Lulu Island is being revived as a visitor and residential destination. In Sharjah, the joint venture with Shurooq delivered Maryam Island, Palace Al Khan and Kalba Waterfront. Overseas projects include Belgrade Waterfront in Serbia.

name: Omniyat
tagline: Dubai luxury developer behind The Opus and One at Palm Jumeirah
founder: Mahdi Amjad, Founder and Executive Chairman
description: Omniyat was founded in Dubai in 2005 by Mahdi Amjad, who remains its executive chairman. The privately held company builds at the top of the Dubai market, commissioning named architects and designers for a comparatively small number of buildings. Its best-known scheme is The Opus in Business Bay, designed inside and out by Zaha Hadid and housing the ME Dubai hotel.

Several projects carry Dorchester Collection branding, among them The Lana at Marasi Bay, ORLA and ORLA Infinity on Palm Jumeirah, and The Alba Residences. Other developments include One at Palm Jumeirah, AVA at Palm Jumeirah, VELA, Anwa, One by Omniyat and The Sterling. The company marked twenty years of trading in 2025 and puts the value of its portfolio at around ten billion US dollars.

name: Devmark
tagline: Dubai development sales and marketing consultancy, founded 2018
founder: Sean McCauley, Chief Executive Officer
description: Devmark is a UAE real estate consultancy founded in 2018 and led by chief executive Sean McCauley. It is not a principal developer: it provides development marketing and sales services to developers, covering project positioning, branding, marketing campaigns and the sales process itself. The business trades under the Devmark Group name and operates through the licensed entity Devmark Real Estate Brokers L.L.C.

Its work includes residential and commercial schemes for third-party developers, among them Soma Residences, Avida Residences and Arka Enclave on Dubai Islands, The Collection at Wasl Gate, The Pier Residence in Dubai Maritime City and the Christian A. Rockefeller Business Tower on Sheikh Zayed Road. Devmark also runs an affiliate marketing arm, Freedm, and distributes stock through a broker network it describes as exceeding 16,000 agents.

name: ADE Properties
tagline: Dubai developer of mid-market apartments in Majan and Jumeirah Village Circle
founder: Mohammed Ahmad Al Dallal, Chief Executive Officer
description: ADE Properties is a Dubai-based residential developer whose projects draw on the Al Dallal family's involvement in the emirate's property sector since the 1950s. The company works mainly in the mid-market segment, building apartment blocks that combine ground-floor retail with studio, one- and two-bedroom homes. Its office is at Bay Square in Business Bay, and its current portfolio sits in Majan and Jumeirah Village Circle.

Barari Gate, announced in 2025, is a 274-unit mixed-use scheme in Majan adjoining Al Barari, with ground-floor retail beneath ten residential levels and completion scheduled for the fourth quarter of 2028. Deansgate, also in Majan, is listed as sold out. Greygate Residences in Jumeirah Village Circle comprises 223 homes - 149 studios and 74 one-bedroom apartments - over fifteen floors, together with five retail units.

name: AG Properties
tagline: Dubai developer of apartment buildings in the Dubai Land Residence Complex
description: AG Properties is a Dubai developer of mid-rise residential buildings, concentrated almost entirely in the Dubai Land Residence Complex. Its schemes are apartment blocks of studios and one- and two-bedroom homes, offered at the more accessible end of the Dubai market and sold largely off-plan. The company publishes little corporate information of its own, and no official website or founding date could be confirmed from a reliable source.

Projects listed as sold out include AG Central, AG Square and AG 7even, all within the Dubai Land Residence Complex. Current off-plan stock comprises AG Ark Tower, AUM Residence and Aum 99 Residences in the same district, with handovers listed between 2027 and 2029. Whitecliffs Residences on Dubai Islands, due in 2027, is the only recorded project outside Dubailand.

name: AYS Developers
tagline: Dubai developer of apartments on Dubai Islands and in Jumeirah Village Circle
founder: Yulia Loshchukhina, Chief Executive Officer
description: AYS Developers, which trades on the property portals as AYS Property Development, is a Dubai developer of off-plan apartment buildings working chiefly on Dubai Islands and in Jumeirah Village Circle. Its Q Gardens series covers studios and one-bedroom apartments, while the Dubai Islands schemes are positioned as waterfront residences. The company is led by chief executive Yulia Loshchukhina and runs regular training sessions for the brokers selling its stock.

Q Gardens Lofts and Q Gardens Lofts Phase 2, both in Jumeirah Village Circle, are complete and sold out, while Q Gardens Aliya in the same community is due in 2027. On Dubai Islands the developer is building Ventone, Tivanno Residence and Breva, with handovers scheduled between 2027 and 2028, and Kusto Aura in Dubai Production City is listed for 2029. In May 2025 AYS set a Guinness World Records title for the largest real estate training session.

name: Casagrand Developers
tagline: UAE arm of Indian developer Casagrand, building its first project on Dubai Islands
founder: Arun MN, Founder and Managing Director
description: Casagrand Developers is the UAE arm of Casagrand Premier Builder, an Indian residential developer founded in 2003 and headquartered in Chennai. The group entered the Emirates in 2025 with its first project outside India, and has said it intends to develop more than six million square feet of residential and mixed-use space in Dubai over the following three years. Its Dubai office is in Business Bay, and Luthfullah K is director for Dubai.

The company's debut UAE scheme is Casagrand Hermina on Dubai Islands, a waterfront development of around 130 apartments valued at about AED 420 million, with one- to four-bedroom layouts ranging from roughly 830 to 2,560 square feet. Construction began in 2026 under contractor Jaseera Building Contracting, with completion reported for 2028. In India the group lists more than 160 projects across Chennai, Bengaluru, Coimbatore and Hyderabad.

name: Citi Developers
tagline: Dubai developer of apartments in Jumeirah Village Circle and on Dubai Islands
founder: Zoraiz Malik, Chief Executive Officer
description: Citi Developers is a Dubai residential developer led by chief executive Zoraiz Malik. It began in Jumeirah Village Circle and has since moved to the Dubai Islands waterfront, marketing its schemes under a 'Neo Luxury' positioning. Its buildings are mid- and high-rise apartment blocks of studios and one- to three-bedroom homes, and the company also has projects under way in Umm Al Quwain. It is not connected to the similarly named bank.

Aveline Residences, a 21-storey building of 263 apartments in Jumeirah Village Circle, was its first Dubai project and was followed by Allura Residences in the same community; both are now sold out. On Dubai Islands it has launched Arya Residences and the two AGUA Residences towers, with handovers listed for 2027. Outside Dubai it is building Amra and Amra Residences 2 in Umm Al Quwain.

name: Deca Properties
tagline: Dubai developer of premium residential and hospitality projects
founder: Saad Haq, Founder and Group Chief Executive Officer, with co-founder Emad Haq as Vice Chairman
description: DECA, which also appears as Deca Properties and Deca Developments, is a Dubai-based developer of premium residential and hospitality projects. It was founded by the brothers Saad Haq, group chief executive, and Emad Haq, vice chairman, and describes itself as a third-generation family business with more than fifty years of combined experience. Alongside its own schemes it works in partnership with other UAE developers, taking a design-led approach from concept through to handover.

In November 2026 the company launched the Lorevia Collection, a series of premium residential developments whose first ten addresses are planned across Dubai, the wider UAE and two European locations. The first of these is a waterfront development at Al Zorah. DECA said at the launch that it intended to bring more than AED 3 billion of new projects to market within six months. Avana Residences in Jumeirah Village Circle is listed among its Dubai schemes.

name: Forum Real Estate Development
tagline: Dubai developer with projects in Jebel Ali and Jumeirah Village Triangle
description: Forum Real Estate Development, which also appears on the UAE property portals as Forum Group, is a developer active in Dubai. Two of its projects are listed publicly: Metropoint, an apartment building in Jebel Ali with handover scheduled for 2027, and FH Residency in Jumeirah Village Triangle, which is complete. Published sources disagree on the company's founding date, ownership and head office, so none of those details is recorded here.

name: GFS Real Estate
tagline: Dubai developer behind the Coventry series of apartment buildings
description: GFS Real Estate, which trades in Dubai as GFS Builders & Developers and GFS Developments, builds mid-market apartment buildings across the emirate's outer communities. Its homes are studios and one- and two-bedroom units sold off-plan on extended payment plans. Michael John Collings is the company's general manager. Reported founding dates and head-office locations differ widely between sources, so neither is recorded here.

The developer's output is branded under the Coventry name. Coventry Garden and Coventry Gardens 2 are in the Dubai Land Residence Complex, Coventry 66 is in Dubai South, where construction began in July 2025, Coventry Centro is in Dubai Industrial City with handover listed for 2028, and Coventry 2 is in International City Phase 2. Bayut named GFS its Emerging Developer of the Month for April 2025.

name: The Heart of Europe
tagline: Kleindienst Group's six-island resort destination on Dubai's World Islands
founder: Josef Kleindienst, Founder and Chairman of Kleindienst Group
description: The Heart of Europe is a resort and second-home destination being built by Kleindienst Group on six islands within The World, the artificial archipelago off Dubai's coast. Josef Kleindienst, the group's founder and chairman, is the master developer. The islands are themed on European countries and cities, and the scheme combines hotels, serviced residences, beachfront palaces and floating villas rather than conventional mainland apartment blocks.

The six islands are Europe Island, Honeymoon Island, Sweden Island, Germany Island, Switzerland Island and the Floating Venice Lido. Announced components include the Floating Venice, Cote d'Azur with its voco Monaco and voco Nice hotels, a Buddha-Bar hotel and floating villas, Portofino Residences and an InterContinental resort. Completion dates have moved repeatedly since construction began, and recent reporting points to phased handovers continuing past 2026.

name: Irth Group
tagline: Dubai developer of Rove Home branded residences and lifestyle offices
founder: Osman Celiker, Chief Executive Officer; founded by the Alshamsi family
description: IRTH Group is a privately held Dubai real estate investment and development company founded by the Alshamsi family, with its corporate office in Vision Tower, Business Bay. It develops hospitality-led branded residences and offices, and is the development partner behind the Rove Home brand created with Rove Hotels. Osman Celiker is chief executive. In 2026 the group added an in-house contracting arm, IRTH Contracting, to bring delivery under its own control.

Rove Home Downtown Dubai launched in 2023 and carries 348 units, with handover expected in 2026. It was followed by Rove Home Marasi Drive in Business Bay, with 809 apartments, and Rove Home Dubai Marina, with 679. On the commercial side the group is building HQ by Rove at Marasi Bay and Haus of Tenet in Business Bay. A multi-year partnership with Rove Hotels announced in October 2026 begins with Rove Home The Greens.

name: Jad Global
tagline: Dubai developer of wellness-led residential towers in Jumeirah Garden City and Al Jaddaf
founder: Mohammed Al Sheikh, Chief Executive Officer
description: JAD Global Real Estate Development is a Dubai-based developer of residential and mixed-use property, working from offices at One Central in the city's trade centre district. The company describes its approach as wellness-led, and its completed and current buildings are mid-rise residential towers rather than master-planned communities. Mohammed Al Sheikh serves as chief executive officer.

Its Dubai portfolio centres on Jumeirah Garden City in Al Satwa, where it has launched 171 Garden Heights and JAD288, alongside J188 in Al Jaddaf and the completed Wadi 645. The company has stated that the value of its Dubai investment portfolio exceeds one billion dirhams, and that further schemes are in design for Meydan, Dubai South, Business Bay, Barsha Heights and Al Barsha South.

name: Mana Comco Real Estate
tagline: Dubai property developer on Prestige Luxury Real Estate's registered list
description: Mana Comco Real Estate appears on the agency's list of registered Dubai developers. No verifiable public information about the company could be found: searches of news archives, developer directories and the main UAE property portals returned no record of its projects, leadership, registration or founding. The details on this page should be confirmed with the Dubai Land Department before they are relied upon.

name: Mashriq Elite
tagline: Dubai residential developer behind the Floarea collection, part of Mashriq Group
founder: Kamran Muhammad, Chief Executive Officer
description: Mashriq Elite Developments is a Dubai residential developer and part of the Mashriq Group, with its sales centre and corporate office in Westburry Office Tower, Business Bay. It builds mid-rise apartment buildings under a single brand, the Floarea collection, and has said its portfolio spans roughly 1,525 residential units with a cumulative value of around 1.5 billion dirhams.

Its first completed building was Floarea Residence in Arjan, a 206-apartment scheme handed over on schedule. Further buildings have followed across Arjan, Discovery Gardens, Jumeirah Village Circle, the Dubai Land Residence Complex, Dubai Production City and Dubai Islands, the last of these being Floarea Breeze, the company's first waterfront project. Kamran Muhammad leads the business as chief executive officer.

name: Nexus Developers
tagline: Dubai developer behind Estrella, a boutique residential mid-rise in Majan
founder: Abdul Samad, Chief Executive Officer
description: Nexus Developer is a Dubai residential developer established in 2020 and led by chief executive Abdul Samad, with Muhammad Arham as chief commercial officer. Its first publicly announced scheme is Estrella by Nexus, a boutique mid-rise of 60 apartments in Majan, off Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. Beyond that launch, little about the company is documented in independent sources, and no corporate website could be confirmed.

name: Object 1
tagline: Dubai developer of apartment projects concentrated in JVC and JVT
founder: Tatiana Tonu, Chief Executive Officer
description: Object 1 is a Dubai developer, registered as Object One Real Estate Development LLC, which builds mid-market and upper-mid-market apartment projects. Company statements describe it as part of the international TSZ Group. Its offices are at Emaar Square in Downtown Dubai, with a second office in Abu Dhabi. Published founding dates vary between sources, so the year the business was established is not treated here as settled.

Its activity is concentrated in Jumeirah Village Circle and Jumeirah Village Triangle, with further projects in Dubai Land Residence Complex, Jumeirah Garden City, Al Furjan, Dubai Sports City and Bukadra. Named schemes include Sky Level 1 and 1Wood Residence in JVC, Elaris Sky and the Luminar towers in JVT, Verdania in Dubai Land Residence Complex and Evergrin House in Jumeirah Garden City. It has also expanded into Abu Dhabi.

name: Octa Properties
tagline: Dubai developer and development manager of branded residences
founder: Fawaz Sous, Founder and Chief Executive Officer
description: OCTA Properties develops and manages branded residential and commercial projects in Dubai, and is one of five businesses within the OCTA Group alongside OCTA Development, House of OCTA interior design, House of OCTA branded marketing and OCTA Investments. It was founded by Fawaz Sous, who remains chief executive, and has represented branded residences in Dubai since 2021. Its office is in Dubai Hills Business Park.

The company works with design and hospitality brands including Missoni, Elie Saab, Franck Muller, Marriott and Westin. Its Dubai portfolio includes Marriott Residences by Octa in Business Bay and Swiss Residences in Dubai Hills Estate, both ready, together with Octa Isle Interiors and Flora Shore on Dubai Islands, Franck Muller Yachting in Dubai Maritime City, Mi CASA in Jumeirah Village Circle and The Golf Terraces in Dubai Production City.

name: Peace Homes Development
tagline: Dubai developer of off-plan apartment towers in JVC and Dubai Land Residence Complex
founder: Ahsan Rasheed, Founder and Chief Executive Officer
description: Peace Homes Development, which also trades as Peace Homes Group, is a Dubai developer of residential apartment buildings. Ahsan Rasheed is its founder and chief executive officer. The company works almost entirely in the off-plan market, concentrating on mid-market towers in established suburban communities rather than prime waterfront or downtown districts, and its buildings are typically sold as studios through to two-bedroom apartments.

Its portfolio falls into two naming families. The Sky series, comprising Sky Suites, Sky Vista, Sky Living and Sky Harmony, sits in Jumeirah Village Circle, while Peace Lagoons and its second phase, together with Sky Line, are in the Dubai Land Residence Complex. Peace Avenue, an 18-storey mixed-use tower, is in Downtown Jebel Ali. In 2025 the company pledged a 50-million-dirham endowment building at Dubai Academic City in support of the Fathers' Endowment campaign.

name: Al Yakka Developers
tagline: Freehold residential development arm of Dubai's SBK Group
founder: Sheikh Suhail bin Khalifa Saeed Al Maktoum, founder
description: Al Yakka Developers, also styled Alyakka, is the freehold residential development arm of SBK Group, a diversified Dubai company owned by Sheikh Suhail bin Khalifa Saeed Al Maktoum, who is named as the developer's founder. The group's property interests in Dubai date back to the late 1990s, and Al Yakka was formed to take that experience into the freehold apartment market.

The company follows a build-first approach, opening sales only once construction has passed the halfway point. Its first freehold scheme, Waha Living in Jumeirah Garden City, comprises 71 residences and began handover on schedule. Ryah Living in Dubai Studio City followed, and the company has since moved into Dubai South with Zura Residences, close to Al Maktoum International Airport.

name: Stamn Real Estate Development
tagline: Dubai arm of Chinese group SIONE Holdings, building residential towers in the emirate
founder: Zheng Jian, Chief Executive Officer
description: Stamn Real Estate Development is a Dubai developer and the international property arm of SIONE Holdings, a group headquartered in Nanchang, Jiangxi province, China, which was established in 1993. The Dubai business operates from Court Tower in Business Bay and is led by chief executive Zheng Jian. Alongside its UAE schemes, the parent group has completed residential projects in Shenzhen, Jiujiang, Zhangshu and Lushan.

Its Dubai portfolio is concentrated in Jumeirah Garden City, where Stamn One and Stamn Yuni are located, with Stamn Two also in Al Satwa. Nautis Residences, launched in July 2025, is a 63-home mid-rise on Island A of Dubai Islands, and Stamn Mia Tower is planned for the Meydan area at Nad Al Sheba. The company has said it has more than 250 million dirhams invested in Dubai.

name: Symbolic Real Estate Development
tagline: Boutique Dubai residential developer and a division of Speedex Group
founder: Mustafa Moiz, Managing Director
description: Symbolic Developments is a boutique residential developer in Dubai and a division of Speedex Group, a UAE company founded in 1991 by Moiz Tayebali Lokhandwala. Mustafa Moiz is managing director of both Symbolic and the parent group. The company runs an experience centre in Al Quoz 3 on Sheikh Zayed Road, and describes its focus as community, wellbeing and sustainability rather than high-volume output.

Its first scheme, Symbolic Alpha in Liwan, was delivered ahead of schedule in 2025, roughly fourteen months after construction began. Symbolic Aura followed in Al Furjan, a 72-home building valued at 150 million dirhams, and Symbolic Zen Residences, also in Al Furjan, was launched at 210 million dirhams. Symbolic Altus, a 108-home building, returns the company to Liwan.

name: Taraf Development
tagline: Boutique luxury developer, the real estate arm of Abu Dhabi's Yas Holding
description: Taraf is the property development arm of Yas Holding, an Abu Dhabi investment group, and was launched as a developer at the start of 2023. It operates from a corporate office in Marina Plaza, Dubai Marina, and describes itself as a boutique, design-led developer working on luxury residential schemes in Dubai and Abu Dhabi. At launch it said it would introduce five properties in the UAE during 2023.

Its first Dubai project was Luce on the Crescent at Palm Jumeirah, followed by Terrazzo Residences and Cello in Jumeirah Village Circle, Terra Golf Collection at Jumeirah Golf Estates and the Karl Lagerfeld Villas in Mohammed Bin Rashid City. In Abu Dhabi the company has announced branded residences with Marriott International and Kerzner International. Several Dubai releases, including Luce and Cello, are recorded as sold out on Property Finder.

name: TownX Development
tagline: Dubai developer of apartments in Jumeirah Village Circle, Arjan and Dubai Science Park
founder: Haider Abduljabbar, Executive Director
description: TownX Development, registered as TownX Real Estate Development, is a Dubai developer founded in 2017 and based at Boulevard Plaza Tower 1 in Downtown Dubai. It builds mid-market apartment buildings in Jumeirah Village Circle, Arjan and Dubai Science Park, selling largely off-plan to investors and owner-occupiers. Haider Abduljabbar represents the company publicly as executive director.

Its earliest completed schemes were Easy18 in 2019 and Easy19 in 2021, followed by Luma21 in 2022 and Luma22, both in Jumeirah Village Circle. Luma Park Views, a 600-apartment development in the same community, was finished ahead of schedule and handover has begun. Current projects are Ashley Hills in Arjan, a 616-unit scheme valued at AED 662 million, and 11 Hills Park in Dubai Science Park.

name: Leos Developments
tagline: UK-founded residential developer with a mid-market Dubai apartment portfolio
founder: Rui Liu, Founder and Chairman
description: LEOS Developments is a residential developer that has operated in the United Kingdom since 2012 and has since built a substantial Dubai pipeline. It was founded by Rui Liu, who is now chairman, and Jake Jacobs was appointed chief executive in January 2026. The company keeps offices in London and at Bay Square, Business Bay, in Dubai, and works across residential, commercial and mixed-use schemes.

Its Dubai portfolio is concentrated in mid-market apartment communities, with Hadley Heights in Jumeirah Village Circle, Cavendish Square in Jumeirah Village Triangle, several phases of Weybridge Gardens in Dubai Land Residence Complex and Knightsbridge in Mohammed Bin Rashid City. More recent releases include Kensington Gardens and Hadley Hills in International City. The company has said it is relocating its headquarters to Dubai alongside a large UAE investment programme.

name: One Broker Group
tagline: Dubai real estate advisory and brokerage, and sales partner to UAE developers
founder: Umar bin Farooq, Founder and Chief Executive Officer
description: One Broker Group, which also trades as OBG, is a Dubai real estate advisory and brokerage rather than a developer in the conventional sense. Founded and led by Umar bin Farooq as chief executive officer, it works from Al Habtoor Business Tower in Dubai Marina and operates across Dubai and Ras Al Khaimah. Its services span sales and lettings, property management, holiday homes, handover and snagging, interiors and mortgage advisory.

The company's principal role is as exclusive sales and marketing partner to developers, advising on product positioning, pricing and payment structures while the developer handles construction. It has reported a sales orderbook of more than 29 billion dirhams across sixteen projects, including hospitality schemes branded with JW Marriott, W Hotels, DoubleTree by Hilton and The Luxury Collection. Projects it has sold include London Gate's Aeternitas in Dubai Marina and Ginco Properties' One Residence in Downtown Dubai.

name: Wadan Development
tagline: Dubai developer launched in 2024, with residential buildings in DLRC and JVC
description: Wadan Developments, registered as Wadan Real Estate Development LLC, is a Dubai developer that launched in 2024 and introduced five residential projects within its first twelve months. It sells from a gallery on the thirteenth floor of Boulevard Plaza Tower 2 in Downtown Dubai, and construction is handled in-house by its contracting arm, Autolink Contracting.

Its first project was Nuvana on Dubai Islands, followed by Seraph and Cybele in the Dubai Land Residence Complex and Tresora in Jumeirah Village Circle. Weston, a seventeen-storey building in the Dubai Land Residence Complex offering furnished homes with smart-home technology, was the most recent launch and has since been extended with a second phase.

name: DAMAC Properties
tagline: Dubai developer of DAMAC Hills, DAMAC Lagoons and branded residences
founder: Hussain Sajwani, Founder and Chairman
description: DAMAC Properties is the property development arm of DAMAC Group, which Hussain Sajwani founded in 1982. The development business was established in Dubai in 2002, as freehold ownership opened to foreign buyers, and Sajwani remains its chairman. The company listed on the Dubai Financial Market in 2015 and was taken private again in 2022. It has delivered roughly 50,000 homes.

Its master communities include DAMAC Hills, built around the Trump International Golf Club, DAMAC Hills 2, DAMAC Lagoons, DAMAC Islands and DAMAC Riverside in Dubai Investments Park. The company works extensively with fashion and hospitality brands, producing towers such as Cavalli Tower, Safa One and Safa Two, DAMAC Towers by Paramount and Chelsea Residences, and it also develops in Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the United Kingdom.

name: Danube Properties
tagline: Property arm of Dubai's Danube Group, known for 1% monthly payment-plan apartments
founder: Rizwan Sajan, Founder and Chairman
description: Danube Properties is the property development arm of Dubai's Danube Group, established in 2014 and chaired by the group's founder, Rizwan Sajan. The Danube Group itself began in 1993 as a building materials trading business in Deira. The developer works mainly in the mid-market and 'affordable luxury' segment of Dubai's residential market, building apartment towers rather than villa communities, and has launched projects across more than a dozen Dubai districts.

The company is widely associated with its 1% monthly payment plan, under which buyers pay instalments during and after construction. Its portfolio ranges from early schemes such as Glitz and Dreamz to recent high-rise launches including Bayz 101 and Bayz 102 in Business Bay, Diamondz in Jumeirah Lake Towers and Oceanz in Dubai Maritime City. Rizwan Sajan remains founder and chairman, and the business is headquartered in Dubai.

name: Sobha Realty
tagline: Dubai luxury developer behind Sobha Hartland, with origins in 1976 Oman
founder: P.N.C. Menon, Founder; Ravi Menon, Chairman of Sobha Group
description: Sobha Realty is a Dubai-headquartered luxury developer whose origins lie in an interior decoration business founded in Oman in 1976 by P.N.C. Menon. The group later expanded into construction and real estate across India and the Gulf, and the related Indian listed company, Sobha Limited, was incorporated in Bangalore in 1995. Sobha Realty now has developments and investments in the UAE, Oman, Bahrain, Brunei and India.

In Dubai the company is best known for Sobha Hartland, a freehold community in Mohammed Bin Rashid City, and for District One, a joint venture with Meydan Group. Later schemes include Sobha One at Ras Al Khor, Sobha Seahaven in Dubai Marina and Sobha Central at Jebel Ali. P.N.C. Menon remains founder; his son Ravi Menon became chairman of Sobha Group in November 2024.

name: Binghatti Developers
tagline: Dubai developer of branded residences with Bugatti, Mercedes-Benz and Jacob & Co
founder: Dr. Hussain Binghatti, Founder; Muhammad BinGhatti, Chairman
description: Binghatti Developers is a Dubai-based developer founded in 2008 by Dr. Hussain Binghatti, who named the company after his late father. It operates as part of Binghatti Holding, with Muhammad BinGhatti as chairman, Ahmed BinGhatti as vice-chairman and Katralnada BinGhatti as chief executive. The company builds residential and commercial projects across Dubai and is recognisable for the repeating, interlocking balcony patterns used on its facades.

Much of its recent output sits in the branded-residence segment, through tie-ups with Bugatti, Mercedes-Benz and Jacob & Co. Business Bay holds Burj Binghatti Jacob & Co Residences and Bugatti Residences, while Mercedes-Benz Places stands in Downtown Dubai. Elsewhere the company has built extensively in Al Jaddaf, Jumeirah Village Circle, Jumeirah Village Triangle, Majan, Arjan and Nad Al Sheba. It has also issued sukuk listed on Nasdaq Dubai.
